newsitem.title: USA: Alpine Group buys Hepworth Refractories.
newsitem.headline: Alpine Group buys Hepworth Refractories.

text.p: The Alpine Group Inc said Tuesday it completed buying all the outstanding shares of Hepworth Refractories Ltd from Hepworth Plc for an all cash purchase price of about $100 million.

Hepworth Refractories, headquartered in Alfreton, Derbyshire, England, is a manufacturer and global distributor of a full range of refractories with about $260 million in annual revenues in calendar 1996.

It operates manufacturing facilities in the United Kingdom, Belgium, France and Canada and supplies a line of refractory products, service and project work worldwide to customers located in over 40 countries, a statement issued by The Alpine Group said.
Hepworth Refractories has a Technical Center in Worksop, England which provides customer support, material analysis and evaluation and new product development, Alpine said.
Alpine said it expects the acquisition to be accretive in the first year and will position the company for further consolidation and strong earnings growth.
